title: Daily balance on a pie chart

prompt.text: A treasurer proposes a pie chart of an account's balance on each of 30 consecutive days. Use code 1 if a pie chart cannot show large numbers, code 2 if its sectors would show shares of a total and hide how the balance changes from day to day, or code 3 if a pie chart cannot show dates. Enter the code only.

content.text: Ask what the 30 daily balances are for: shares of something, or one quantity changing over time.
Think about what a pie chart is built to show, and what the reader wants to see from one day to the next.
The 30 balances are not parts of one whole: the treasurer wants to see the balance move from day to day. A pie chart would show shares of a total and hide that change.
